A YouGov and Economist state-level estimate showing South Dakotans disapprove of President Trump does not come from a poll conducted specifically among residents.

According to The Economist’s state-level estimates, only Idaho, Wyoming and West Virginia have positive net approval ratings for Trump. The poll lists his approval rating in South Dakota at -13. In the latest Economist/YouGov survey, Trump is exiting August with a 33 percent approval rating, a new low for him in that poll.

Trump’s polling in the Decision Desk HQ (DDHQ) average did see a slight increase Thursday, reaching 39.2 percent.

Still, this average marked the second-lowest released by DDHQ since May, when Trump averaged 38 percent. The polling average also found that 57.5 percent disapproved of the president.
results.title: Trump’s approval ratings endure a cruel summer
